output_list.code: function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) { require(balances[msg.sender] > _value); require(balances[_to] + _value > balances[_to]); balances[msg.sender] -= _value; balances[_to] += _value; Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value); }
output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function uses 'require' statements to check for conditions, but these conditions are not sufficient to prevent reentrancy attacks. An attacker can exploit reentrancy vulnerabilities to manipulate balances and transfer tokens multiple times.
